cardinality.rule: genericViewportDisplaySetMetadataProvider.add: the descriptor is not a literal here: delete its kind, and give a video or an ECG descriptor its image id as imageId (was sourceDataId)

displaySetRegistry.add: a volumeId no longer makes a planar viewport show a volume: the viewport shows this display set as a stack in its acquisition plane unless its mount asks for mode: 'volume' (setDisplaySets({ displaySetId, options: { mode: 'volume' } }) or addDisplaySet(displaySetId, { mode: 'volume' })); a 3D viewport shows it as before
